name: devforgeai
description: DevForgeAI for Codex: structured brainstorming, product requirements, requirement-linked architecture decisions, and documentation updates grounded in verified changes.

interface.shortDescription: Brainstorm, write PRDs, resolve architecture, and update docs.
interface.longDescription: Explore ideas with Brainstorm. Turn promoted brainstorm ideas into product requirements with PRD. Resolve architecture questions using bounded evidence, explicit decision acceptance, and requirement readiness. Update README files, changelogs, and guides from Git evidence with Documents Updater.
defaultPrompt: Brainstorm ways to improve customer onboarding.
Update the documentation for my uncommitted changes.
